info.title: 医疗一人项目 API
info.description: W15 local research workbench. Immutable datasets and analyses, versioned plans, project knowledge, validated Office/PDF exports and an explicitly authorized mock mailbox use real PostgreSQL state; unavailable capabilities are reported explicitly.
